source: Final locally built production-source offline /demo workspace
data: Offline representative fixtures. connect-src none; no controller access.
editing: Real working demo interaction states captured through CUA, edited with timed holds, smooth cursor motion, click cues and on-screen captions. This is an edited walkthrough, not an uncut screen recording. No UI or readings fabricated. Desktop viewport captures fit proportionally; Framing focuses on the complete traces workspace or the relevant pot details; outer page navigation is cropped in the chart scenes. Important demonstrated controls remain visible. The output is rendered at 2560x1600 from 1920x1200 captures.
